unified_rule: Empirical midrank percentile: old=(P_content497+P_hybrid479)/2; new=P_content497. If no usable original MF support, use P_content497 for all. No answer-based calibration or tuning.
percentile: (N-1-average_zero_based_desc_rank)/(N-1); all equal =>0.5; N=1 =>0.5. Ties share percentile, final ID ascending.
exclude: All saved assessed product IDs; Support5 are always excluded. This is a live recommendation flow, not unchanged offline holdout evaluation.
